The beginning remains patient in feeling, but the story itself keeps moving. Each detail points toward the next turn instead of sitting alone. The account has begun.

The watcher is left asking whether they really saw what they saw. The ending returns to the image that made the subject memorable. The story has moved, but it does not need to close every door.
